title: default theme broken
body:
I believe the default theme on the [CDN](http://cdn.jsdelivr.net/instantsearch.js/1/instantsearch.min.css) is missing most classes. It has styling for pagination and sliders, but not for search box, hits, etc.

Also note that the default theme pointed to [here](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#custom-themes) returns a [404](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/css/instantsearch.scss).
